content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways provide a solution for digital sellers who are locked out of conventional platforms. These gateways enable you to accept cryptocurrencies without requiring extensive identity verification, thus ensuring a seamless transaction process. This matters because it allows you to sell digital products such as templates and courses without losing a significant portion of your income to high processing fees or being restricted by regional regulations. With platforms like NOWPayments charging only 0.5% per transaction, you can keep more profits and serve a global audience unrestricted by traditional payment barriers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind no-KYC payment gateways is designed for efficiency and autonomy. At its core, it integrates various free-to-use tools such as Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Google Drive for file delivery. When a customer makes a purchase, a transaction is recorded using NOWPayments, which ensures automatic verification on the blockchain. This architecture allows for swift payment processing without the need for an intermediary, meaning you own the complete stack of your digital store. With these components working in harmony, you can operate your business independently and securely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This payment gateway solution is specifically designed for digital creators who find themselves in regions where traditional payment platforms are either unavailable or charge exorbitant fees. If you sell ebooks, courses, or any digital products, you can leverage this infrastructure to ensure that your sales are processed smoothly and efficiently. By utilizing no-KYC gateways, you gain the freedom to conduct business on your terms, without the constraints imposed by companies like Stripe and PayPal. This setup empowers you to reach a broader audience while maximizing your revenue potential.
Retain more profits by avoiding high platform fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of no-KYC payment gateways lies in their interconnected components. Utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency processing, these elements form a cohesive system. Google Sheets can serve as your order management platform, allowing you to track sales and customer data without incurring additional costs. Each component is selected based on its ability to enhance the overall efficiency of your digital store. This architecture doesn’t just work; it empowers you to maintain full control over your business operations.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start leveraging a no-KYC payment gateway for your digital sales, first, set up your hosting on platforms like Cloudflare Pages. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions without KYC obligations. Ensure you have a reliable file delivery system in place, such as Google Drive. Load your products into your chosen order management system, and conduct thorough testing to ensure everything functions as expected. Finally, promote your digital store to start generating sales, and consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for comprehensive blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments, which accepts cryptocurrency. This gateway allows you to process payments efficiently while retaining more of your earnings due to lower fees compared to traditional platforms. With the right setup, such as Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Google Drive for file delivery, you can create a fully operational digital store.
Maintain full control of your digital sales infrastructure.

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without the constraints of traditional payment platforms, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need to build and deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, allowing you to sell directly without platform fees. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can sell an ebook by using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. Combine this with a reliable hosting service and file delivery system to streamline the process.

Using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal fees. This setup maximizes your earnings by avoiding high processing costs associated with traditional platforms.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by setting up your own digital store using an architecture that includes Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments. This approach eliminates reliance on platforms like Gumroad.
What are the advantages of using a no-KYC payment gateway?
No-KYC payment gateways reduce fees, ensure privacy, and allow for quick transactions. This is essential for digital creators who want to maintain control over their sales.
How does NOWPayments compare to platforms like Gumroad?
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% fee. This difference can result in substantial savings for digital sellers, especially at higher sales volumes.
